# Hippocrates AI — Dual-Engine Clinical Intelligence

> Hippocrates is an advanced healthcare AI platform delivering dual-engine intelligence: Aegis for patient health understanding and consultation preparation, and Oracle for physician clinical decision support and differential reasoning.

Canonical Website: https://hippocrates.in

## Core Products

### Aegis — Patient Health Intelligence
- Target Audience: Patients, families, and individuals seeking health literacy.
- Core Function: Translates complex medical terminology, provides structured symptom exploration, explains laboratory reports (e.g., CBC, lipid panels, thyroid profiles), and assists patients in preparing organized questions for clinical consultations.
- Limitations & Safety: Aegis is strictly an educational and communication preparation tool. It does NOT diagnose medical conditions, prescribe medication, or handle medical emergencies.
- Emergency Guidance: In cases of severe chest pain, shortness of breath, acute neurological deficits, or severe bleeding, patients are directed immediately to emergency medical services (108/112 in India, 911 in US) or the nearest emergency room.
- URL: https://hippocrates.in/aegis

### Oracle — Physician Clinical Copilot
- Target Audience: Licensed physicians, residents, and verified healthcare providers.
- Core Function: Augments clinician workflows through multi-model differential diagnostic reasoning, evidence-based guideline synthesis, clinical risk score computation (e.g., CRB-65, CURB-65, Wells criteria), and case documentation support.
- Verification Requirement: Requires valid Medical Council Registration Number before granting clinical workspace access.
- Non-Autonomous Safeguards: Oracle is a clinical decision support system (CDSS) designed to reduce cognitive fatigue and anchor bias; it does not replace the physician's independent clinical judgment.
- URL: https://hippocrates.in/oracle
